name: Person
description: A human being known to the user — themself, family, friends, colleagues, contacts.

attributes.name: aliases
attributes.description: Alternative names/nicknames used to refer to this person.

attributes.name: organization
attributes.description: Where they mainly work or study now — their primary Membership. Assigning closes the old one and opens a new one; history('organization') lists past ones.

attributes.name: relationship
attributes.description: What they are to the owner, read from the relations between the owner and them. Assigning a label ("friend", "recruiter", "former manager") records such a relation.

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: Their role in their primary Membership. Set organization first.

attributes.name: assistant
attributes.description: The assistant whose owner this person is. Derived — set Agent.owner to change it.

attributes.name: facts
attributes.description: Facts recorded about this person. Derived — record one with add_fact.

attributes.name: descriptions
attributes.description: How this one has been described, in whoever's words — several are normal, because people describe the same thing differently and each telling is worth keeping.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: The latest of this one's descriptions, as one string. Writing it adds a description; they all live there.

methods.name: send_email
methods.description: Send an email to this person's `email`. Requires `email` to be set.

methods.name: add_fact
methods.signature: add_fact(predicate: str, value: str, confidence: float = 1.0) -> Preference
methods.description: Record a Preference/Fact instance about this person and link it via `subject`.

methods.name: research
methods.description: Ground/enrich this person's attributes via live search (Tavily) when little is known about them.

relations.partner: their spouse or partner — one at a time
relations.authority: whom they manage; managed_by — their manager
relations.service: services they provide; served_by — their doctor, landlord, recruiter

what_to_say: their full name as the user says it, who they are to the user, where they live, when they were born if it came up — enough to know them again when the name is said differently next time
brief: a human being known to the user
